headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 2, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game, with Emilio Pagán earning the win. The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4, securing a crucial win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed Will Klein on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The San Francisco Giants placed Jesus Rodriguez on the 10-day injured list with right elbow neuritis. The Pittsburgh Pirates placed Ryan O'Hearn on the 10-day injured list with a left quad strain. The Seattle Mariners placed Luke Raley on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, with a left forearm strain.

The New York Yankees made a significant trade, acquiring OF Luis Cruz and C Omar Alfonzo from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Camilo Doval. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a trade, acquiring C Bo Naylor and RHP Codi Heuer from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for CF Blake Perkins and RHP Craig Yoho. The Baltimore Orioles traded RHP Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins for OF Jhomnardo Reyes.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game, with Emilio Pagán earning the win. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Orioles in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4, securing a crucial win. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Andrew Painter pitched 6 strong innings for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and George Springer contributing to the winning effort. Jordan Walker and Alec Burleson were among the impact hitters for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Logan Gilbert led the Mariners' pitching effort, while Trevor Larnach and Brooks Lee had standout performances for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Dodgers RHP Will Klein Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Will Klein has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort.

top_news.title: **Yankees Acquire OF Luis Cruz in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees made a move on August 1, 2026, acquiring outfielder Luis Cruz from the Pittsburgh Pirates. In exchange, the Yankees traded right-handed pitcher Camilo Doval to the Pirates.
